text: 6.35 Change of Location / Inclusion of Additional Location with BOA Approval BOA may consider change of location of EOU / EHTP / STP / BTP unit from place mentioned in Lo P to another and / or to include additional location outside territorial jurisdiction of original DC / Designated Officer, subject to such conditions as BOA may decide.
